'''Amp''' was a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] member of the [[77th Air Wing]]'s [[Sword Squadron (Imperial)|Sword Squadron]]. During the [[Battle of Kelrodo-Ai]] in the [[Western Reaches Operation]] of the [[Reconquest of the Rim]], he flew under [[Blade Squadron (True Invids)|Blade Squadron]] with the call-sign [[Blade Two (Galactic Empire)|Blade Two]]. Amp was one of the few survivors of the battle, as well as one of three members of the squadron directly responsible for the destruction of the [[Hypermatter reactor/Legends|hypermatter annihilator]] for the [[Citadel of Axes]]' shield generator (the others being [[Starks]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Shea Hublin]]).
